The '''Imperial Department of Munitions Resource Development''' was a department of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was responsible for overseeing the production of materials important to the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], including the [[Dynamic Synergetics, Inc.]]'s [[Hyperbaride/Legends|hyperbaride]] [[DSI Hyperbaride Synthesis Plant|processing plant]] on [[Marca/Legends|Marca]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Aaz'del Hutrick]] served as the [[Director/Legends|director]] of the department.
